map.土石坝填筑密度控制 使用指南: Earth and Rock Fill Embankment Compaction Control User Guide
map.输入填筑料湿密度、含水率与最大干密度，计算压实干密度与压实度（相对密实度），对照: Enter the fill material's wet density, moisture content and maximum dry density to compute the compacted dry density and compaction degree (relative density), judged against the code for fill quality — for field quality control of earth and rock fill dams and levees.
map.碾压参数（遍数、层厚）定干密度。: Rolling passes and lift thickness set the dry density.
map.压实度校核是否达设计要求。: Check whether compaction meets the design requirement.
map.含水率偏离最优时复压调整。: Re-roll to adjust when moisture content deviates from optimum.
map.：现场干密度 2.05、最大干密度 2.12 → 压实度 = 2.05/2.12: : field dry density 2.05 and maximum dry density 2.12 → compaction = 2.05/2.12 ≈ 96.7%, meeting the ≥96% requirement.
map.：最优含水 12.5%、实测 10% 偏干，洒水复压可提密度。: : optimum moisture 12.5%, measured 10% is too dry — sprinkling and re-rolling raises the density.
map.干密度是实测，压实度是现场干密度与室内最大干密度之比，控制指标。: Dry density is measured; compaction is the ratio of field dry density to the laboratory maximum dry density — the control index.
map.近最优含水时易压实到高密度，过干或过湿都难达标。: Near the optimum moisture content it is easy to compact to high density; too dry or too wet both struggle to reach the target.
